faq.a: Aafaq is used as a male name.

faq.q: How is Aafaq written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aafaq is written آفاق in Arabic and آفاق in Urdu, and आफ़ाक़ in Devanagari.

faq.a: The root of Aafaq is أ-ف-ق (ʾ-f-q).

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aafaq?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aafaq total 17, reducing to 8. Number 8 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aafaq?
faq.a: Aafaq appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Afaq, Aafaaq, Aafak.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aafaq?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aafaq include Aafaaq, Aafak.

faq.q: Where is the name Aafaq used today?
faq.a: Aafaq is used in Arabic, Urdu naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it, so no popularity score is asserted.
